title: Deal Initiation in Mergers and Acquisitions

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (publicly listed U.S. firms, excluding financial services and utility industries)
context.sample_description: U.S. M&A deals from the SDC Platinum M&A database with deal value exceeding $5 million, both acquirer and target publicly listed U.S.-domiciled firms not in financial services or utility industries, legal form of a merger or acquisition of majority interest, completed status; matched with CRSP and Compustat databases
context.sample_size: 1,639 deals (1,268 with a known deal initiator)

data_sources.name: Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP)
National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER) recession dates
analyst forecasts of target earnings (dispersion and accuracy)

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: also split by ALL_EQUITY, ALL_CASH, TENDER, MERGER subsamples

key_ivs.name: TARGET_INITIATED
key_ivs.measure: [withheld: wording matches the source]

dv.name: Target financial distress, performance, financial constraint, and shock measures
dv.measure: ALTMANS_Z_SCORE, INTEREST_COVERAGE_RATIO, LIQUIDITY, BOOK_LEVERAGE, S&P long-term credit rating, stock price below $5; CHANGE_IN_ROA, CHANGE_IN_TOBINS_Q, SALES_GROWTH, MARKET_SHARE_GROWTH, BHAR; SA/KZ/WW financial-constraint indices; industry shock index and time-series shock indicators; 2001/2008 recession

key_ivs.name: TARGET_INITIATED
key_ivs.measure: 1 if target initiated, 0 if bidder initiated (grouping variable)

analyses.label: Table 4 - Predicting Target-Initiated Deals (probit regressions, Columns 1-2)

key_ivs.name: ALTMANS_Z_SCORE
key_ivs.measure: Altman's Z-score (target financial distress)

key_ivs.name: LIQUIDITY
key_ivs.measure: target liquidity ratio

key_ivs.name: CHANGE_IN_ROA_OVER_PAST_3_YEARS
key_ivs.measure: change in target ROA over past 3 years

key_ivs.name: BHAR_OVER_PAST_1_YEAR
key_ivs.measure: target buy-and-hold abnormal return over past 1 year

key_ivs.name: HIGH_HHI
key_ivs.measure: high industry concentration indicator (target industry competition)

key_ivs.name: SA_INDEX
key_ivs.measure: Size-Age financial constraint index (Hadlock and Pierce 2010)

key_ivs.name: INDUSTRY_SHOCK_INDEX
key_ivs.measure: first principal component of seven industry-level variables (Harford 2005)

key_ivs.name: 2001_ECONOMIC_RECESSION
key_ivs.measure: indicator = 1 for deals announced Sept. 2000 to May 2002

key_ivs.name: 2008_ECONOMIC_RECESSION
key_ivs.measure: indicator = 1 for deals announced June 2007 to Dec. 2009

key_ivs.name: PRIOR_INDUSTRY_TARGET_INITIATED_DEAL_&_AUCTION_ACTIVITY
key_ivs.measure: [withheld: wording matches the source]

key_ivs.name: INSTITUTIONAL_SHAREHOLDING_CONCENTRATION
key_ivs.measure: HHI of institutional shareholdings (col. 2 only)

key_ivs.name: INSTITUTIONAL_OWNERSHIP
key_ivs.measure: percentage of shares owned by institutions (col. 2 only)

key_ivs.name: TOBINS_Q
key_ivs.measure: target Tobin's Q (col. 2 only)

analyses.label: Table 5 - Multivariate Analysis of Target Premia (OLS, Columns 1-4)
